name: CouponCodeFree: Automatic Coupons + Cashback for Free
description: Go to the website where you want to shop and use the 'CouponCodeFree' extension to apply discounts and save instantly
author: TpDevPro

action.default_title: CouponCodeFree: Automatic Coupons + Cashback for Free

privacy.purpose: The extension uses the 'activeTab' permission to apply discount codes automatically to the tab you are currently viewing. The 'scripting' permission is used to execute scripts that apply these codes and manage interactions with the page. We use remote code access to fetch the latest discount codes and cashback offers, ensuring that you always get the best deals. All data is handled securely in compliance with our privacy policy.
